title: Owner-relative path need
description: Bounded request data, never a grant. Only Root resolves the authenticated owner's home; SDK resolution is a lexical preview without filesystem or authorization effects.

path.description: Normalized relative path or trailing /** subtree; ** alone means the authenticated home subtree. No absolute path, empty/dot/dotdot segment, backslash, colon, environment placeholder, control or other * pattern. SDK helpers also enforce 4096 UTF-8 bytes and 255 bytes per literal segment.
